structured.answer: The site can't yet calculate about 35 things, all marked "לא מחושב". For me the ones that matter are gold ETCs and gold funds, everything to do with FX (dollar-hedged funds, dollar deposits, FX accounts, the exchange-rate fee), REITs, structured products, savings policies and ביטוח מנהלים, corporate bonds, robo-advisors and portfolio management. On top of that it will never cover loans, other insurance, stock picking or derivatives, physical real estate, ranking by past returns, or executing anything. Plain index ETFs seem to be covered.

findings.what: The heading promises 'מוצרים', but many items aren't products: LBMA Gold Price (a benchmark), עמלת חליפין (a fee), נאמן and חברת דירוג (roles or companies), הסדר חוב (an event), מענק (a feature), היוון קצבה מוכרת, תיקון 190 and תשלומים פטורים (tax mechanics)

findings.what: The FX conversion fee isn't calculated, and that's exactly the hidden cost on US-listed ETFs
Overlap between the temporary and permanent lists (insurance, real estate) is confusing
